About About The NYC Innovation Hot Spot provides business incubator services to qualified entities to facilitate company growth and encourage job creation. The Hot Spot, based in Harlem, coordinates a rich regional entrepreneurial ecosystem, partnering with 45 local incubators across all five boroughs of NYC. Operated in coordination with the leadership of the NY I-Corps Hub at the City University of New York , the Hot Spot provides these incubators and their members opportunities to

Operated in coordination with the leadership of the NY I-Corps Hub at the City University of New York , the Hot Spot provides these incubators and their members opportunities to participate in NSF I-Corps Lean LaunchPad entrepreneurship training and to access certain New York State tax benefits.
The Hot Spot accepts referrals from these incubators for Innovation Hot Spot consideration.
For any general inquiries, please email info@nycinnovationhotspot.org Follow us on LinkedIn ! © NYC Innovation Hot Spot, 2026 bottom of page

Frequently Asked Questions: What is the application process for NYC-BPC Spring 2021? All Teams who would like to compete must begin by completing the 2021 Student Application . Applications for NYC-BPC are due March 22, 2021 PLEASE NOTE WHEN APPLYING: For the New York City Regionals (NYC-BPC), you are not required to submit a slide deck or video in the application. Who is eligible to compete in the New York Business Plan Competition (NYBPC)? Eligible applicants

Eligible applicants are any graduate, undergraduate, and/or community college students enrolled part- or full-time in accredited New York colleges and universities during the current academic year (2020 - 2021).

Training #1 – NYC BPC Lean Bootcamp Program The Lean Bootcamp Program (LBC) covers Customer Discovery, the Business Model Canvas, specifically Value Propositions and Customer Segments, and Agile Development.
How do I enroll in the optional training program offered by the NYC-BPC?
After applying, you will receive an email within 3-5 days from the NYC-BPC Program Team with further details on enrolling.
Please include “NYC-BPC” in your email subject line.
You will receive an email from the NYC-BPC Program Team on March 22, 2021, the application deadline, with full details on the competition and Final Slide submission instructions.
